header:
Awesome Health and Fitness Tech

> Open-source workout trackers, nutrition databases, wearable data tools, habit trackers and health data libraries. Every entry shows its license. **Rules of this list:** every repo exists, is public, is not archived, states a license and has had a commit in the last year. One plain sentence each. Star counts and claims are the authors' own, we did not test every tool. Checked 2026-10-18. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
footer:
## How to choose

- **Not medical advice.** Talk to a doctor for health decisions.
- **Health data is private.** Prefer tools that store data locally or self-hosted.
- **Check the license.**
- **Wearable formats change.** Check the last commit.

## Contributing

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). One entry per pull request, plain words, real sources only.
